'''Star Tours Flight 613''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Ord Cantrell/Legends|Ord Cantrell]]. On the day of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], it was on time and set to arrive at Gate 1A at 1525 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 1620.
